schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Must match the parent directory name.

version.description: Semver of this manifest. Bumped on every content change. Used to detect updates.

name.description: Display name (untranslated; brand names stay as-is).

description.description: Short blurb shown in the catalog.

icon.description: Icon file path relative to app.json (e.g. 'icon.png').

defaultLocale.description: BCP-47 source locale for i18n/<locale>.json files.

category.description: Catalog category used by the client to group/filter apps. Open list — extend as needed.

translatableString.description: Either a literal string or 't:<key>' resolved from i18n/<locale>.json.

hostPath.description: Host path. For scope=perUser, Wisp appends a per-user subdir at session start.

volumeGrouped.description: Multiple sub-mounts sharing a single host/container root. Each mount maps {hostPath}/{name} → {containerPath}/{name}. The client may expose an advanced mode to override individual paths.

hostPath.description: Host root path. Each sub-mount appends its name.

containerPath.description: Container root path. Each sub-mount appends its name.

name.description: Leaf name appended to both hostPath and containerPath.

features.description: Open feature map. Known features are typed below; unknown features pass through and emit a warning at load time.

provider.description: Provider id. Built-ins: 'steam' (scans Steam library), 'heroic' (scans Heroic install dir), 'library-file' (reads a JSON file the container generates — see containerPath). Unknown values disable the feature with a warning.

containerPath.description: For 'library-file': absolute path of the JSON file the container writes ({version:1, shortcuts:[{externalId,name,iconUrl?,launchParams?}]}). For other providers: the directory the provider scans.

featureMods.description: Declares that the app supports user mods. Wisp handles discovery, download, and extraction; the app declares only the source to query and where to land the content inside the container.

source.description: Source identifier Wisp queries for available mods. Built-ins: 'gamebanana'. Unknown values disable the feature with a warning.

targetPath.description: Absolute container path where Wisp extracts downloaded mod content. Supports `${var}` interpolation against the target game's library entry — available vars: `${titleId}` (the externalId when it's a resolved title id), `${platform}`, `${name}`. Use a literal path when mods share a single root (e.g. Cemu graphic packs all live under graphicPacks/), or interpolate per game (e.g. Eden's per-title load/<titleId>/ layout).
